lists.label: Adult sites
lists.does: Blocks sites made only for grown-ups.

lists.label: Gambling sites
lists.does: Blocks betting, casino and lottery sites.

lists.label: Scam sites
lists.does: Blocks sites known for fake offers, fake shops and fraud.

lists.label: Phishing sites
lists.does: Blocks sites that pretend to be a bank or an account page to steal a login.

lists.label: Malware sites
lists.does: Blocks sites known for spreading viruses and harmful downloads.

lists.label: Drug sites
lists.does: Blocks sites that sell or promote illegal drugs.
